scope.summary: Implement the ML-backed retouch primitives, native and local-first in studio-engine per STU-RAS-030: Inpaint/object remove (brush over an unwanted region and synthesize a fill from surrounding data using an on-device model) and Content-aware move (move/extend a selected object and content-aware fill the vacated area, with structure/color adaptation and transform-on-drop). Runs offline; any generative/provider variant is an optional §10 adapter (MT-065), never the only implementation.
proof_targets: offline inpaint synthesis + content-aware move runtime + snapshot
expected_tests: live: brush over an object and confirm inpaint synthesizes a plausible fill on-device (no network); content-aware move relocates an object and fills the vacated area
test: inference runs in studio-engine offline; degrades to a clear state if a model asset is absent
argus: before/after inpaint snapshot + run receipt
acceptance_criteria_original: inpaint/object-remove + content-aware move run on-device offline
baseline is native; adapter optional; structure/color adaptation proven

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Inpaint, object remove & content-aware move

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-026]** Studio MUST provide the following deduped retouching family as one primitive group operating on pixel layers and, where the target allows, directly on placed-asset layers: *Derivation: catalogue table, splits per row; yields 9 microtasks, one per retouching tool.* | Tool | Normative behavior | |---|---| | Clone stamp | Paints exact pixel copies from a sampled source point with aligned sampling, sample-layer scope, cross-document sources, and a clone-source overlay. | | Healing brush | Paints from a sampled source or pattern while matching texture, lighting, and shading of the destination. | | Spot/blemish heal | Removes small blemishes by painting or single click, auto-sampling repair texture from the surroundings with no source point. | | Patch | Repairs a drawn or selected region by dragging it over source pixels, in normal or content-aware mode with structure and colour adaptation. | | Content-aware move | Moves or extends a selected object and content-aware fills the vacated area, with structure/colour adaptation and transform-on-drop. | | Inpaint / object remove | Brushes over an unwanted region and synthesizes a fill from surrounding data using an on-device model. | | Red-eye | Removes red flash reflections with pupil-size and darken controls while preserving eye detail. | | Dust and scratches | Removes small defects by radius and threshold; also available as a live filter (14.9). | | Frequency separation | Splits an image into low-frequency colour and high-frequency detail bands for retouching, and recombines them. |
**[STU-RAS-030]** Content-aware operations are native and on-device per [STU-RAS-143]. --- ### 12. Blend Modes

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
